archetypes.name: parity
archetypes.rationale: The retired Bash path had nuanced classifier and attempt-history behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python stall recovery helper against the retired Bash contract. Focus on generic-profile classification, sanitized KV outputs, same-cause repeat detection, and append-only attempt history. Check that moved contract files still drive lint parity. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: cutover
archetypes.rationale: This change deletes a large runtime shell surface and rewires multiple callers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit all caller cutovers from the retired report shell to python/cli.py stall-recovery. Pay special attention to argument ordering, environment propagation, design failure reporting, and Makefile/relevant-check mappings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: public-surface
archetypes.rationale: Stall recovery reports can publish sanitized failure data upstream.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Tier A and Tier B report paths for accidental disclosure regressions. Focus on sensitive corpus construction, bounded root-cause validation, bail-token sanitization, and public dedup/comment slices after the Python-only cutover. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
